# SurvivorCount — the exact number of open positions

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean · **Diagram:** [Foundations: wheels, cycles and columns](../../GRAPH.md#foundations-wheels-cycles-and-columns)

The number of positions in the combined cycle that survive every wheel is the product, over the wheels, of the open positions on each one: one at the wheel of size 2 and two fewer than the wheel size elsewhere for twin primes, and the wheel size minus `w` for a general pattern.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [Euler's totient function (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler%27s_totient_function) — the product formula over the primes, the single-number case of this node's counts
- [First Hardy-Littlewood conjecture (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Hardy%E2%80%93Littlewood_conjecture) — the local factors of the singular series, which are this node's per-wheel open-position counts divided by the wheel size

## Claims

<a id="twin_survivor_count"></a>
### `twin_survivor_count`

Twin-pattern survivors of the combined cycle: 1 at the wheel of size 2, two fewer than the wheel size elsewhere, multiplied.

```lean
/-- **Twin-pattern survivors.** The positions of the combined cycle that
survive the twin pattern number exactly the product over the active wheels
of: 1 at the wheel of size 2, and two fewer than the wheel size elsewhere. -/
def twin_survivor_count : Prop :=
  ∀ limit : Nat,
    (wheel_survivors limit).card = ∏ q ∈ active_primes limit, (if q = 2 then 1 else q - 2)
```

**Rests on:** [`CRT.crt_map_bijective`](CRT.md#crt_map_bijective)

**Proof:** `RNS.SurvivorCount.twin_survivor_count_step` in [`RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)

<a id="local_survivor_count"></a>
### `local_survivor_count`

On one wheel, the wheel size minus w positions survive an offset pattern.

```lean
/-- **Survivors on one wheel.** On the wheel of size `p`, exactly `p` minus
`w` positions survive an offset pattern: each distinct position the pattern
occupies blocks one position. -/
def local_survivor_count : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Finset Nat) (p : Nat) (hp : p.Prime), (local_survivors_gen T p hp).card = p - w T p
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.SurvivorCount.local_survivor_count_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean)

<a id="general_survivor_count"></a>
### `general_survivor_count`

Survivors of the whole cycle: the product over the active wheels of the wheel size minus w.

```lean
/-- **Survivors of the whole cycle.** For any offset pattern, the positions of
the combined cycle surviving every active wheel number exactly the product,
over the active wheels, of the wheel size minus `w`. -/
def general_survivor_count : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Finset Nat) (limit : Nat),
    (wheel_survivors_gen T limit).card = ∏ q ∈ active_primes limit, (q - w T q)
```

**Rests on:** [`CRT.crt_map_bijective`](CRT.md#crt_map_bijective)

**Proof:** `RNS.SurvivorCount.general_survivor_count_step` in [`RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SurvivorCount.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)
